import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
from aeread.shared_runner.task.execution import ProviderRequest, _reasoning_block
from aeread_families.procurement_grounding.bakeoff import OpenRouterBatchClient

@dataclass
class MockModel:
    name: str
    def removesuffix(self, suffix):
        if self.name.endswith(suffix):
            return self.name[:-len(suffix)]
        return self.name

@dataclass
class MockProviderRequest(ProviderRequest):
    def __init__(self, reasoning_effort=None, reasoning_token_budget=None):
        self.model = MockModel("test-model")
        self.instructions = "test instructions"
        self.input_text = "test input"
        self.seed = 12345
        self.max_output_tokens = 1000
        self.output_schema = {"type": "object"}
        self.reasoning_effort = reasoning_effort
        self.reasoning_token_budget = reasoning_token_budget
        self.temperature = None
        self.top_p = None
        self.tools = []

async def test_reasoning_logic():
    # Test case 1: No reasoning controls -> should omit reasoning field
    req1 = MockProviderRequest()
    body1 = OpenRouterBatchClient._wire_body(req1)
    print(f"No controls - reasoning in body: {'reasoning' in body1}")
    
    # Test case 2: Only effort -> should include reasoning with effort
    req2 = MockProviderRequest(reasoning_effort="medium")
    body2 = OpenRouterBatchClient._wire_body(req2)
    print(f"Effort only - reasoning in body: {'reasoning' in body2}")
    if 'reasoning' in body2:
        print(f"  reasoning content: {body2['reasoning']}")
        
    # Test case 3: Only token budget -> should include reasoning with max_tokens
    req3 = MockProviderRequest(reasoning_token_budget=500)
    body3 = OpenRouterBatchClient._wire_body(req3)
    print(f"Budget only - reasoning in body: {'reasoning' in body3}")
    if 'reasoning' in body3:
        print(f"  reasoning content: {body3['reasoning']}")
        
    # Test case 4: Both -> should include reasoning with both
    req4 = MockProviderRequest(reasoning_effort="low", reasoning_token_budget=300)
    body4 = OpenRouterBatchClient._wire_body(req4)
    print(f"Both - reasoning in body: {'reasoning' in body4}")
    if 'reasoning' in body4:
        print(f"  reasoning content: {body4['reasoning']}")

import asyncio
asyncio.run(test_reasoning_logic())
